_note: Enforces each new swing strategy's declared market-trend tag against trader.core.trend_structure's UPTREND/SIDEWAYS/DOWNTREND state machine - the price-action course's own swing-structure method (HH+HL / LH+LL after 2+ swings, break of market structure -> SIDEWAYS), NOT trader.core.market_trend's separate IBD-style VD-day/FTD engine (that module is untouched and still used by scripts/market_trend.py). The tag itself now lives in each STRATEGY's own config as `market_regime_tag` (moved out of this file on 2026-10-25 - see trader/filters/base.py's class docstring and each strategy's own config _note). A strategy with no `market_regime_tag` set is NOT gated at all (weekly_rsi_sma20 excludes this filter outright via its own exclude_filters, since it was never tagged). Enabled by default: with no tagged strategy enabled this is a no-op, so it's safe to leave on.
